steps.content: You close the Eastside forum chat, rubbing your brow as you mentally sort through the intelligence on the "artwork thieves" gathered over the past few days.
First, the Marauders operate as a group, one that recently infiltrated Eastside with clear, specific objectives: they only target rare artworks.
Second, their methods are exceptionally violent, far from the theatrical flair typically associated with phantom thieves.
More critically, the Marauders are highly skilled and will resort to force without hesitation.

...Something doesn't fit. You recall the brief confrontation yesterday at the museum: the figure's demeanor and movements were nothing like the brutish enforcers described in the intelligence reports.
Unless the thief recognized you and was deliberately performing.
Enough. Best to leave this to the specialists. You shake your head, unlock the terminal, and send quick messages to a few contacts.
